title: Dublin City Marathon — Water Station Volunteers
description: Each year our group mobilises volunteers — parents, Scouts, Senior Cubs and Leaders — to operate a water station at the Dublin City Marathon. In 2025, 66 volunteers manned the 22-mile station on Fosters Avenue from 7am through to the final walkers. A brilliant community effort representing the very best of 1st Meath Dunboyne.

title: Ventures Table Quiz 2025
description: Our Ventures section ran a fundraising table quiz in May 2025. A fantastic night of questions, fun and community spirit that helped fund the Ventures programme for the year ahead — including their trip to Kandersteg International Scout Camp in Switzerland.

title: Support the Group
description: Want to support 1st Meath Dunboyne Scout Group? We are always grateful for community support. Whether through volunteering at events, donating equipment, or sponsoring activities, get in touch to find out how you can help us continue delivering a great programme for young people in Dunboyne.
